description: Returns the release calendar payload with MCP Apps metadata so compatible clients render the interactive Release Calendar App inline. Suited to requests to show, display, visualize, or render a macro release calendar, such as 'show me the AUD release calendar'. Optional `indicator`, `start_date`, and `end_date` filters narrow the calendar to a series, month, week, day, or date range; `timezone` adds local times for a specific city or region. Supported currencies: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur. The `indicator` parameter lists the accepted indicator slugs. Access: USD keyless; others: subscription_required with a subscribe link.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code (case-insensitive). Supported: lowercase 3-letter catalogue currency, e.g. usd or eur.

indicator.description: Optional indicator slug to narrow results. Supported: catalogue indicator slug, e.g. inflation or policy_rate.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for an additional converted timestamp, for example America/Sao_Paulo.

name: release_calendar_visual_artifact
